column1: # Hand-labelled gold set drawn from pkgs/by-name — the ONLY measurement this
# project has on its actual target population. Every other number in the repo is
# measured on the legacy tree, whose distribution differs sharply.
# Selection bias, stated plainly: these are well-known packages chosen because
# their category is not in doubt. That makes them EASIER than average, so scores
# here are an upper bound, not an estimate of corpus-wide accuracy.
# Judgment calls: TUI programs (lazygit, btop, ncdu) are labelled by the taxonomy
# gloss "graphical or full-screen interactive interface", which puts full-screen
# TUIs under `application`. Reasonable people would say cli-tool. Where a label is
# genuinely arguable the row is marked with a trailing "?" comment.
